    Order of Draco¶

    [!INFO] The Dragon's Oath — Eris's Draconic Blade The sword-hand of the Empire, sworn to the Apostle Draco — black dragon on gold, and they do not break.

    History¶

    One of the two order states of the Erisian Empire alongside the Ever Order, the Order of Draco traces its charter to the early consolidation of Central Erisdar under the Erisian crown. Named for Draco, one of the Apostles of Eris, the Order was granted lands, fortresses, and the right to recruit across the 38 counties and 4 free cities in exchange for perpetual service as the Empire's heavy reserve.

    Unlike the secular duchies (-berg) and counties (-stadt) of the imperial subdivisions, Draco holds its territory as a religious-military corporation — part of the Empire, yet self-governing under its Grandmaster. Its knights fought at the front of the Crusade of 278 AGD that took half the lands of the Mann tribes, and its banners were the first to fly over the converted marches before Kosbaldo's rebellion reclaimed them.

    The Draco knights remember Baoth differently than the chroniclers do. Where the Ruins now drown a dragon kingdom, Draco sees a warning: a dragon king who trusted the wrong oath (Goldenborn and Rulfred). Their motto answers it: Oath kept, dragon fed.

    Patron¶

    Draco, Apostle of Eris. In Erisian hagiography Draco is the apostle of endurance and iron discipline — the dragon who knelt to Eris. The Order's chaplains teach that Draco's black scales were not color but oath-iron, and every Draco knight who takes the final vow touches a reliquary said to contain a scale from Draco's own mantle (in truth, iron from the Meble forges of Sousu, kept polished to a lie).

    The chaplains answer to the Pontificate of Eris in doctrine, but to the Grandmaster in discipline — a tension that has kept Draco more loyal to Central Erisdar than to any pontiff.

    Sigil¶

    A black dragon rampant on a gold field, wings folded, clutching a white Erisian cross. Bordered in imperial crimson when fielded alongside the Erisian Empire's own banners. Knights of rank add a single silver star of The Silver Bride above the dragon's head — not piety but politics, a reminder that even the heavens are under Eris's dominion, as the Empire claims.

    Role¶

    Draco is the Empire's armored fist: heavy cavalry, fortress engineers, and garrison knights. Its companies hold the border marches between Central Erisdar and North Erisdar, ride as shock troops when the Erilian Federation moves against Mann, and provide the honor guard for the Kennberg court at need. Recruitment favors second sons of county knights and proven men-at-arms — birth matters less than oath-keeping, a rare meritocratic streak the Empire tolerates because it works.

    Relation to Currencies & Regions¶

    Paid and provisioned in Erilia, the cracking coin of Central Erisdar. The Draco treasury at Draco-burg mints no coin of its own — it draws from the Erisian exchequer and from its own estates, then spends in Erilia at Elboria and Kennberg markets. For foreign purchase of Romanium dust and northern silver, its factors exchange Erilia for Alegorian Crown at the Northaxeland border and for Silver Talon in East Erisdar.

    Its fortresses sit astride the roads from Central Erisdar to Loren and Magna; every toll is taken in Erilia, every mercenary contract priced in it — the Order is one of the few institutions still propping the currency's trust.
